label: GOD_NAMING senses: laws, rigid equivalence, separations and joint model, checked
meaning: Premise-free comparison of the descriptive (GOD_NAMING_1) and reference-fixed (GOD_NAMING_2) senses of the name 'God' under a box. Reference-fixed names are rigid, and by the rigid-designation library their actual co-designation persists wherever the bearer exists, while strict necessary co-designation is equivalent to necessary existence (necessity of identity in Kripke's sense, which gives no necessary existence). The rigid reading of the necessary-being node is equivalent to the box K node, and so is the descriptive reading with the route's own world-independent description. For a description that varies by world, the descriptive reading and the box K node do not entail each other in general: in explicit models where the corresponding bridge fails, that direction fails; a joint model satisfies both nodes and both bridges. Model-witnessed separations; no premise is established.
